items.item_text: 01. Faculty Minimum Qualifications Questionnaire: Please indicate how you meet the minimum qualifications for this faculty position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. Minimum Qualifications: Have a bachelor’s degree or higher and two years of professional experience; OR, any associate degree and six years of professional experience; OR the equivalent*. NOTE: Professional experience must be directly related to the assignment being taught. Options: I hold a completed Bachelors degree (or higher) and at least two (2) years of related professional experience. | I hold a completed Bachelors degree (or higher) but DO NOT have at least two (2) years of related professional experience and am NOT applying for Equivalency. | I hold a completed Associates degree and at least six (6) years of related professional experience. | I hold a completed Associates degree but DO NOT have at least six (6) years of related professional experience and am NOT applying for Equivalency. | I am applying for Equivalency and have attached my Equivalency Review Request Form to my application. | I have already been granted Equivalency for this discipline and have attached my previously approved Equivalency documentation to my application. | I do NOT meet any stated minimum qualifications and am NOT applying for Equivalency.
Have a bachelor’s degree or higher and two years of professional experience;
, any associate degree and six years of professional experience;
the equivalent*. Professional experience must be directly related to the assignment being taught. All degrees must be from an accredited institution completed by time of hire.

Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment.
